title: Matrix unit-minor normalization over a local ring assuming localized modules are free.
statement: Given finite free scalar extensions over a local ring and a map whose residue has one-dimensional kernel, the map is equivalent by source and target linear equivalences to (u,a) ↦ (u,g(a)) with a free complementary target module C.

proof.text: Choose bases for the finite free source and target. Over the residue field, rank-nullity and the one-dimensional kernel give rank one less than the source rank; select a nonzero maximal minor. Its determinant lifts to a unit, so elementary row and column operations over the local ring reduce the matrix to a diagonal identity block and a one-column map g. The selected and complementary coordinates provide U, C, and the stated linear equivalences.

proof_origin.note: Stage-3 decomposition; standard unit-minor matrix argument from Stacks Tags 00NX and 00O0.
